meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?
This is the restaurant's signature dish.

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: someone who carries heavy things for a living
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: Fresh greens are placed on the plate.
I was born and grew up here.
We were putting it into boxes.
A big box was standing on the floor.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: to lie, to be lying down, to rest

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
The book is lying on the table.

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

meanings.note: used to address a child you don't know

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Don't be nervous, everything is fine.

обижаться.gloss: to take offence, to be hurt

meanings.en: to take offence, to get upset

examples.trans: Don't be offended by my words.
I know this town really well!
I love our town very much.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.

examples.text: Она нашла себе мальчика на побегушках!
examples.trans: She found herself an errand boy!

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

meanings.en: dishes, plates and cups, tableware (collective singular)
meanings.note: мыть посуду = to wash the dishes

examples.trans: Get up and go wash the dishes!
Clean tableware is on the table.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
The kitchen has run out of fresh arugula.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

meanings.en: to save, to rescue from danger

examples.text: Все прибежали тебя спасать — и я, и папа!
examples.trans: Everyone came running to save you — both me and Dad!

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to take cover

examples.text: Вы вообще в свою комнату спрятались!
examples.trans: You hid in your own room altogether!
The cat hid under the bed.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

терпеть.gloss: to bear, to put up with; to hold on

meanings.en: to put up with, to bear

meanings.note: e.g. to wait for the toilet

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.

meanings.note: possessive adjective from чёрт; Чёртов мост = Devil's Bridge

examples.trans: Let's pull under Devil's Bridge over there.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: Someone tipped over the rubbish bins.
Put the letters in the box.
